neighbours.label: a word-piece inside a long German or Hungarian proper name (Junghe|in|rich, Stein|me|ier, E|gy|etem)
fire: The contract went to Rheinmetall after a long tender.
Our guide, Herr Weinheimer, met us at the station.
The lecture was held at Eötvös Loránd Tudományegyetem in Budapest.
A lawyer named Steinbrenner handled the sale of the house.
The trucks were built by Jungheinrich for the warehouse.
Chancellor Kiesinger opened the new bridge in the spring.
The parcel was shipped from Bietigheim-Bissingen on Tuesday.
Professor Meierhofer published the study with a colleague, Dr. Steinmeier.
quiet: The contract went to a local builder after a long tender.
Our guide, a tall student, met us at the station.
The lecture was held at a large university in the capital.
A lawyer named Brown handled the sale of the house.
The trucks were built by Ford for the warehouse.
The mayor opened the new bridge in the spring.
The parcel was shipped from Boston on Tuesday.
Professor Hill published the study with a colleague, Dr. Reed.
